Located on Oxford High Street near the famous landmark of Carfax Tower, La Taberna retains its original eighteenth century features, mirroring the elegance and ancient charm of Seville. Here, we follow the rhythms and pace of Spanish cuisine and hospitality, with simple, delicious tapas dishes. Stop in to experience perfectly defined nuances of Spanish flavours; fresh olives, organic cold pressed virgin olive oil, smoked paprika and saffron paired with renowned Spanish wines, cocktails, beers and sangria. Our mission is simple: to bring people together over exceptional food and memorable moments in one of the most beautiful settings in the Lake District.
